listing.name: Dune II (Dune Dynasty)
listing.summary: Play Dune II with enhanced controls, widescreen rendering and skirmish battles.

steps.title: Finish setup before registering a prepared copy
steps.instruction: Use a permitted complete Windows Dune Dynasty copy with your own European Dune II 1.07 PAK files, following upstream’s FILELIST.TXT. Keep those data files in the prepared data directory or the actual personal Dune Dynasty/data directory used by the copy. Missing original data makes normal startup fail; attaching the engine alone does not prepare it. Optional music, soundfonts and enhancements have separate requirements and rights. The ordinary launch uses no arguments. Retain any supported arguments your prepared copy already needs and review its actual working directory.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. Engine licensing does not grant rights to original game assets, music, mods or bundled components.
Before updating the game, keep a copy of its working files and every location containing saved data. Choosing a different executable does not give it a separate profile.

Do not create an executable-side config merely to register the game. Preserve that whole actual profile, its save directory, configuration, original data, custom campaigns/music and the old creating runtime before replacement. Original-format save reading is not a promise that every newer save works in an older engine.

references.title: Dune Dynasty profile and compatibility notes
references.instruction: Keep dunedynasty.cfg: an existing executable-side config selects portable state; otherwise Windows normally uses the current account’s roaming AppData/Dune Dynasty profile. Do not create an executable-side config merely to register the game. Preserve that whole actual profile, its save directory, configuration, original data, custom campaigns/music and the old creating runtime before replacement. Original-format save reading is not a promise that every newer save works in an older engine.

data_locations: the complete personal Dune Dynasty profile or the actual executable-side data and configuration of your prepared copy

preparation.title: Put your own European Dune II v1.07 PAKs in the personal data folder before Play
preparation.instruction: Follow upstream’s FILELIST.TXT and place the original files in %APPDATA%/Dune Dynasty/data. Keep the managed game folder clear of original files and executable-side dunedynasty.cfg so the player uses the external profile.

warnings: The managed route covers Windows x86-64. Back up the external Dune Dynasty profile separately. Keep using an independent upstream copy for executable-side profiles and other packages. Real saves across versions remain unverified.
